datasets.name: Sentinel-2A remote sensing image data
datasets.verbatim: Sentinel-2A satellite remote sensing data obtained from the official website of the USGS (United States Geological Survey, http://www.usgs.gov) were used for landslide extraction.

datasets.name: Historical landslide data (for ground truth)
datasets.verbatim: For the dataset, first, according to the historical landslide data, the landslides in the study area were vectorized and labeled on Google Earth through visual interpretation.

methods.name: Attention U-Net landside extraction model
methods.summary: An improved U-Net semantic segmentation model that incorporates the Squeeze-and-Excitation Network (SENet) channel attention mechanism after each skip connection to adjust feature channel weights, enhancing landslide feature learning and reducing false/missed detections.

availability.author_statement: The data that support the findings of this study are available from the corresponding author upon reasonable request.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is not referenced or linked, and the custom code for the Attention U-Net model is not provided. While Sentinel-2A data is accessible via USGS, the lack of code and ground-truth data prevents reproduction.
